The disassembly resynchronises at 0x0017F5B4 with an explicit '.arm' directive and then decodes real ARM (b, bl 0x6731EC, vmov.f32/vsqrt.f32/vmla.f32 on [r4,#0x98]/[r4,#0x9c]/[r4,#0xac]), so everything Ghidra reports here is garbage.
